sql.tournamentPool.getDetails: select tp.*, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(tb))) FROM ( SELECT tpu.id, tpu.user_id as "userId", concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) as "fullName", tpu.tournament_pool_id as "tournamentPoolId", tpu.archived FROM brs.tournament_pool_user tpu inner join flow."user" u on tpu.user_id = u.id WHERE tpu.tournament_pool_id = tp.id AND tpu.archived is not true) tb), '[]') AS "users" from brs.tournament_pool tp where tp.tournament_id = :tournamentId and tp.tournament_pool_type_id = :tournamentPoolTypeId
